verdicts.reason: A: the photo is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail, and the decorative bar marks are blown up into a large, meaningless 'pause' glyph that fills the dead space in the middle. The quote and the G.M. Allen box do read cleanly left to right with reasonable gaps. B: the big decorative mark is jammed right against the quote text and the small mark is crammed against the photo. The attribution box nearly touches 'LONGEST,' and the whole thing looks crowded and collision-prone, with the thumbnail photo just as trivialised as in A.
